summary: Finward Bancorp filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by First Financial Bancorp. Each Finward share will be exchanged for 1.35 shares of First Financial common stock; no per-share dollar price or premium is stated. Boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal. The merger is expected to close in Q4 2026, pending shareholder and regulatory approvals. The transaction structure is a stock-for-stock merger with Finward merging into First Financial. Watch for shareholder vote timing, regulatory clearance, and relative stock price convergence for risk-arb spread.
